topic: AgX gamut-inset path-to-white tonemapping vs per-channel Notorious Six hue skew rig
topic_zh: AgX 色域内缩与向白退饱和色调映射对比逐通道 Notorious Six 偏黄死角畸变
scope: Deterministic AgX-style gamut-inset chromaticity attenuation and hue-invariant path-to-white filmic tonemapping versus naive per-channel S-curve clipping across 17 HDR exposure stops (-2.0 EV to +6.0 EV). No neural color grading execution.

robustness.name: Sampled 17 HDR exposure stops (-2 EV..+6 EV) preserve exact opponent hue angle and smooth path-to-white

good_fit: Real-time 3D game and virtual-production HDR display rendering transforms (campfires, explosions, laser sabers, sunset clouds, neon signage)
Explaining why independent per-channel S-curves drive non-primary colors into the Notorious Six corners (Yellow, Cyan, Magenta)
Scaling the chrominance offset vector (C - Y*1) isotropically around luminance Y for 0.00° hue skew and zero trig calls
Desaturating over-exposed emissive cores smoothly toward white (Path-to-White) like physical film and digital cinema sensors
not_for: Already-tonemapped 8-bit sRGB UI textures or web graphics that must bypass the 3D scene-referred display transform
False-color scientific thermal heatmaps where deliberate rainbow hue rotation encodes temperature tiers
Neural image-to-image color grading or style transfer models
Strict colorimetric proofing where out-of-range values must hard-clip without filmic roll-off
